newsitem.title: USA: CBOT okays longer Project A hours for financials.
newsitem.headline: CBOT okays longer Project A hours for financials.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade board late Tuesday approved extending by 45 minutes trading hours for financial contracts only on its Project A overnight electronic trading session, a CBOT board bulletin said.

Under the proposal, which needs Commodity Futures Trading Commission approval, overnight Project A trade in financial products such as U.S. Treasury bond futures would close at 0645 CST/1245 GMT instead of at the current 0600 CST/1200 GMT.

The change would take effect Jan 16, 1997, and stay in effect pending the May 9, 1997, start of CBOT's link with the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
